{{Quote|Is that when you were wounded? In the Kessel encounter?''"<br />"''That's right.|[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and Checkers|<ref name="Stealth" />}}
The '''Kessel encounter''' was a battle fought<ref name="Stealth" /> by [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Laser Company]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Company/Legends|unit]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] against an anti-Republic force during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Except for the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Checkers]], all members of Laser Company were [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the fight, and Checkers himself was severely wounded.<ref name="Stealth" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of Kessel was mentioned in ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'', a [[2009]] novel written by [[Karen Miller]].<ref name="Stealth" />
